key_concepts: The Moon is Earth's natural satellite
The Moon's appearance from Earth changes over time
The changing appearance of the Moon is called phases
There are eight phases of the Moon
The observed phase depends on the Moon's position in its orbit around Earth
Moon phases can be modeled using a light source, a sphere, and an observer
The Moon's appearance can be recorded daily in a moon log
Basic information about the Moon includes its shape, dimensions, motions, appearance, and
